messages:
sara: hey team — seeing a jump in error rate for /v1/infer and /v1/embeddings since ~09:12 PDT, mainly 502/504 and a handful of 429s. Where's the canonical dashboard + traces for quick triage? cc @dan

dan: start with Grafana -> 'API › errors by route' panel (workspace tag = prod). Datadog APM service 'inference-api' is the fastest way to get traces: service:inference-api AND error:true. If you give me the spike window I'll pull a trace id.

linh: Grafana link (short): https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd/errors-by-route?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now. For logs use Loki: `{job="inference"} |= "ERROR" |= "502"` or a regex: `{job="inference"} |~ "(timeout|502|504|429)"` — set the range to 20m.

matt: two quick checks: 1) ratelimiter metrics (ratelimiter.requests, ratelimiter.rejects) — 429s might point to upstream throttle. 2) gpu/model-worker pool saturation: infra/gpu-util dashboard.

sara: spike window roughly 1756503000-1756503300 (UTC). grabbed one trace id: `trace:1f4c3a` — can someone look?

dan: pulling it now... trace shows repeated small waits then an upstream 504 from model-proxy. pattern = proxy returning 503/504 after model-worker queued/timeout. suspect queue build-up or an OOM on worker. I'll check node pods and GC.

observability-bot: Alert: inference-api.errors.rate > 0.5% for 5m — triggered at 1756503150. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.company/INC-1234

matt: if proxy timeouts are the cause we can either increase model-proxy timeout to 60s temporarily or scale the model-worker pool. prefer scale first. @eng-platform can we bump autoscale for that pool?

linh: alert tuning suggestion: use a 10m window and exclude 4xx from bots. example query: `sum(rate(errors{status!~"4..",env="prod"}[10m])) / sum(rate(requests{env="prod"}[10m])) > 0.005`. Also exclude /health and /metrics routes from the error numerator.

dan: good call. dashboards already have a top-level filter: route !~ /health.* — make sure alert uses the same filter.

sara: i don't want to change prod alerts mid-incident. action items: Dan to check model pool and pods; Matt to confirm autoscaler behavior; Linh to paste exact Grafana + Loki queries into runbook; i'll watch errors and mute pager if mitigations happen. :+1:

matt: k8s autoscaler did one scale event at 09:14 (3 -> 5). k8s events show a burst of requests around 09:13 and a bunch of ratelimiter rejects. logs show many 429s starting 09:13.

dan: follow-up: found two model-worker pods with high GC and one pod OOM at 09:13, restarted the affected pods, they came back healthy and 504s dropped. looks like memory pressure + traffic burst.

sara: status update: error rate back to baseline for last 10m. do we want a full postmortem? small customer-facing errors but short-lived. if not, short incident note + runbook update to include early scale trigger and exclude bot 4xx.

linh: i'll update the runbook with the Grafana panels, Loki queries and the alert query changes. i'll open a PR: https://git.redwood.company/r/runbooks/pull/42

sara: great — thank you. i'll close the pager and mark incident resolved. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-service inference-api v1.22.3 to prod completed at 1756503400 by matt
